name: eevee_viewport_transparent_jittered_shadow_accumulates
purpose: Verify that an Eevee rendered viewport accumulates static hashed transparent materials with transparent shadows while viewport jittered shadows are enabled.
passCriteria: The test captures an early viewport frame and a later accumulated viewport frame from a static semi-transparent hashed shadow caster. The later frame must have substantially lower high-frequency noise while the scene content remains visible, proving film history is not discarded every sample.
